articles.title: Manchester United Hires New Manager Mauricio Pochettino
articles.summary: Pochettino has taken over at Manchester United following Michael Carrick's departure, bringing his extensive experience in European soccer.
articles.content: The international soccer break has come to an end, and European leagues are back in action. The resumption of matches brings a fresh slate of challenges for teams across the continent. Manchester United's recent managerial change is one of the most significant storylines heading into this period. Following Michael Carrick's departure as manager, Mauricio Pochettino has taken over at Old Trafford, bringing his extensive experience in European soccer to the role. With a proven track record at Southampton, Tottenham, and Chelsea, he will be expected to turn around United's fortunes quickly. Manchester United is currently struggling in 18th place in the standings, making Pochettino's task even more daunting. His first match as manager of the Red Devils will be against Liverpool at Anfield, a formidable opponent that will test his skills from the very start. The English giants have a lot to prove under their new leadership, and it remains to be seen how well Pochettino can adjust to the Premier League's fast-paced environment. Pochettino faces an uphill task in his inaugural season at Manchester United, where one misstep can be met with intense scrutiny from fans and media alike. Delivering immediate results while laying the groundwork for a sustainable future will be a delicate balancing act for Pochettino as he navigates the complex landscape of Old Trafford. The club's history is marked by periods of turmoil since Sir Alex Ferguson's departure, making it essential for Pochettino to establish a new trajectory and inject fresh energy into the team. Meanwhile in Spain, Jose Mourinho's Real Madrid side has made an impressive start to the season, winning a thrilling El Clasico match against Barcelona. Mourinho's team is now just three points behind Hansi Flick's side and is well-positioned to challenge for the LaLiga title this year, with the possibility of success hanging precariously in the balance. The Madrid outfit has bolstered its squad with some astute signings over the summer, including Kylian Mbappe and Jude Bellingham who are expected to reach their prime soon. These additions have been complemented by a talented crop of young players who could play a pivotal role in shaping the club's future and driving it towards new heights. The influx of fresh talent has sparked high hopes among fans that Mourinho can lead Real Madrid back to the pinnacle of Spanish football, where they can reclaim their status as LaLiga champions. The pressure is mounting on Mourinho as he looks to make an instant impact at his new club, and a major trophy in his first season would be a significant milestone. However, there are other European teams making waves that could potentially steal the spotlight from Manchester United's new manager. In Serie A, one team stands out for its impressive performances both domestically and internationally - Como. Under the guidance of Cesc Fabregas, the team has established itself as a force to be reckoned with in the league-phase standings of the UEFA Champions League. Its success is largely due to the talents of players like Nico Paz, an Argentine star who is now being touted as a potential leader for his national team following Lionel Messi's retirement. Fabregas' task will be to balance Como's ambitions in both domestic and European competitions while also managing player fatigue - playing every three days can take its toll on even the most experienced athletes. The upcoming season promises to be a challenging one for several European teams, with uncertainty surrounding potential sanctions that could impact their future prospects. Bahnsen's unique blend of Scandinavian playfulness and Japanese functionality is set to be reimagined in her second collaboration with Uniqlo, which promises to merge her signature style with the brand's utilitarian sensibility. This fusion will be showcased through a range of womenswear and childrenswear pieces designed to keep you warm during the winter months. The collection, now available online, marks the culmination of Bahnsen's six-month design process, where she drew inspiration from various sources including her friendship with artist Fumiko Imano. The two collaborated on the campaign shoot in Sweden, amidst a picturesque landscape that perfectly captured the essence of Bahnsen's designs. Bahnsen has shared the story behind her new collection, revealing that it was influenced by "sisterhood" and the joy of exploring nature together with her son, who often helps her collect flowers for inspiration. The Uniqlo collaboration has given Bahnsen the opportunity to reimagine the classic fleece in her signature romantic and nostalgic style. This personal touch is evident in the palest shade of soft pastel pink fleece, adorned with delicate embroidery featuring small flowers. Bahnsen's own personal preference for the collection is the pale pink fleece, which she finds perfect for layering on countryside outings. She believes that the romance and nostalgia associated with the color pink adds a unique touch to the collaboration. This subtle yet elegant approach has resulted in a cohesive and stylish lineup. The entire collection is designed with layering in mind, with each piece complementing the others to create a versatile wardrobe. Bahnsen suggests taking inspiration from her runway shows, where she often pairs oversized jumpers or fleeces with flowy dresses for a chic and effortless look. Bahnsen's latest collection for Uniqlo showcases her ability to infuse everyday pieces with a touch of sophistication and elegance. By pairing oversized jumpers or fleeces with flowy dresses, she creates a look that is both chic and effortless. The result is a range of timeless pieces that are perfect for braving the cold while still looking stylish. Bahnsen's attention to detail has elevated the Uniqlo collection, making each piece feel unique and romantic. This collaboration marks a new direction in the brand's offerings, one that prioritizes quality and style over fleeting trends. articles.title: Winter officially begins in New York City marked by visible jackets on streets
articles.summary: Vogue editors predict the hottest winter coat trend will feature extraordinary details and strong shoulders.
articles.content: Winter has officially begun, marked by a sudden appearance of jackets on New York City's streets. From sidewalks to subway cars and restaurant entrances, every type of coat imaginable is now visible, including trenches, puffers, shearlings, bikers, blousons, and gorpy jackets in various shapes, colors, and fabrics. As we take stock of the season's offerings, Vogue editors are weighing in on what they believe will be this winter's hottest coat trend. We asked our team to share their educated guesses about which coats would reign supreme during the 2026-27 season. Their responses offer a glimpse into the most coveted outerwear pieces. Laird Borrelli-Persson, senior archive editor, predicts that next season's standout coat will be one with extraordinary details and strong shoulders, reminiscent of the forthcoming Met Gala's opulent aesthetic. As winter's chill sets in, fashion enthusiasts are eagerly anticipating the latest coat trends. Hannah Jackson, a senior fashion writer, notes that high-end coats can be out of reach for many, citing Ives' £6,500 Reconstituted Vintage Fur and Silk Robe Coat as an example. The funnel neck coat is poised to take center stage this winter, with its structured yet sleek silhouette making it a standout choice. Phoebe Philo's luxe trench and leather versions are already gaining attention, but budget-friendly options like Mango's gray wool style offer an accessible alternative. Prada devotees will be thrilled by the brand's statement coat, which made its runway debut in January. This show-stopping jacket boasts a classic khaki cotton design with a twist: fraying edges and crumbling seams reveal subtle hints of traditional houndstooth patterns. The Prada coat's enduring appeal lies in its versatility, it can easily be paired with everyday outfits, but its price tag remains a significant drawback for many. With five-figure prices like this, it's clear that the world of high-end fashion is still out of reach for those on a tighter budget. High-end fashion is all about making a statement, and this season's coat trends are certainly doing just that. With prices reaching into five figures, it's clear that luxury brands are pushing the boundaries of opulence. Max Berlinger, senior fashion news editor at Vogue, has been eyeing a lightweight plaid mackintosh, specifically one with a classic approach to the pattern and a long design. Berlinger recently spotted a promising candidate on Massimo Dutti's shelves, priced at an affordable $490. In contrast, some of this season's most sought-after coats are coming in at eye-watering prices. Phoebe Philo, the legendary designer behind Céline's success, is often credited with popularizing the mockneck bomber jacket. This style has become a dominant force on runways and streets alike, with Alexandra Hildreth, fashion news writer at Vogue, attributing its widespread appeal to Philo's influence. The Phoebe Philo Rib Neck Black Leather Jacket, priced at $8,000, is a prime example of this trend. Meanwhile, novelty overcoats are causing a stir in the fashion world, with decadent details taking center stage. These coats might not be the most practical or warm, but they're certainly making an impression. From velvet opera coats to jacquard dusters and vintage fur-trimmed satin coats, designers are pulling out all the stops to create truly show-stopping pieces. The winter season has brought out the most extravagant coats from designers worldwide. Nour Hammour's collection is a prime example of this trend, featuring shearling and faux fur-trimmed coats that make outerwear truly extra. Outerwear is making a statement this winter, says Madeline Fass, fashion director at Vogue Shopping. The Sophie 90s Leather Jacket from Nour Hammour, priced at $2,120, is just one of the many show-stopping pieces we've seen. The Kallmeyer Henri Floral Metallic-Jacquard Coat and Colleen Allen High Collar Velvet Coat are also making waves in the fashion world. The brand Arma has been gaining momentum since its presentations in New York and Paris last season. Their leopard coat, which has been photographed by Phil Oh multiple times during Fashion Week, is a testament to their growing popularity. We've seen our jackets being worn by Vogue girls on several occasions, says Irene Kim, editorial production manager. As the fashion world continues to evolve, it seems that designers are drawing inspiration from unexpected places. With Tom Ford's Cry to Heaven collection on its way and Pope Leo's cultural influence, monastic silhouettes may be emerging as a new trend. The latest crop of coats is drawing inspiration from medieval times, but don't expect austere silhouettes. Instead, designers are blending monk-like severity with modern minimalism to create a look that's both dramatic and understated. Designers such as Mame Kurogouchi and Max Mara have already sent out their fall 2026 collections, featuring coats that are more ornate than plain. Meanwhile, Catalogue NYC is offering slim, gently cinched versions of the classic coat, while La Collection is adding a touch of decadence with its Margaret blazer. Spanish women, known for their flair for good outerwear despite milder winters, have been incorporating rich colors and textures into their coats. La Veste's pop-up in New York has showcased sumptuous wool blazers and car coats in vibrant hues like violet, chartreuse, and funky combo stripes. Anna Cafolla, news editor, notes that this season's coats are a response to the sleek, streamlined looks of recent years. She points to Dries Van Noten's Opulent Puffer as an example of what she means - a coat that's rich, opulent, and decadent in every sense. This plushy Dries Van Noten coat in an acid tone stands out for its sumptuous surface and regal collar, according to Max Berlinger. Berlinger singles out this particular coat as a prime example of opulence, noting the lavish details that make it a standout piece. articles.title: Grand Theft Auto 6 Can Be Played Remotely
articles.summary: Grand Theft Auto 6 has finally arrived, but not everyone is fortunate enough to play it at home. Those who are away on work trips or vacations, stuck in meetings or dealing with a packed...
articles.content: Grand Theft Auto 6 has finally arrived, but not everyone is fortunate enough to play it at home. Those who are away on work trips or vacations, stuck in meetings or dealing with a packed schedule, can still experience the game's thrill. Some gamers have already started exploring Vice City and taking down corner stores as Jason and Lucia, but many more people are yet to join them. Fortunately, there is a way for those who are not at home to play GTA 6 remotely. The game may be console-locked to the PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X and S, limiting its accessibility, but there's still hope for gamers on-the-go. By taking advantage of remote play features, players can enjoy GTA 6 even when they're away from their main gaming setup. Players who have a PS5 or an Xbox with GTA 6 downloaded and ready to go can experience the game through smaller devices while they are away from home. This means that gamers will not miss out on any action-packed moments of the modern Bonnie and Clyde story. To access remote play on Xbox consoles, users must first navigate to the Profile & System settings within the Xbox guide. From there, they need to select the Devices & Connections menu and choose Remote features as their next step. Once in the Remote features section, gamers will find options to enable or disable this feature, allowing them to tailor it to their needs. To pair a remote play device with an Xbox console, users must put their console into sleep mode while enabling the remote features option. Gamers can use smartphones, tablets, and Windows computers as remote play devices with their Xbox consoles. The PlayStation Portal offers a convenient solution for playing GTA 6 away from home without needing third-party gaming devices or tablets. Its design retains the familiar DualShock controller layout, providing an intuitive and natural gameplay experience that's hard to beat when using remote play features on the PlayStation 5. GTA 6 is not yet available on PC, which means gamers who want to take the game with them on the go have limited options for now, excluding the use of remote play devices. Leaving your console on at home remains a necessary step if you plan to access GTA 6 remotely through any device. To access GTA 6 remotely through any device, a stable internet connection and a compatible gaming platform are essential. The latest consoles from Sony and Microsoft offer varying levels of portability, with some being more convenient to carry than others. The PS5 Slim is one such example, weighing in at under six pounds, making it easier to transport compared to its larger counterparts. However, sacrificing performance for the sake of convenience may not be ideal for gamers seeking the best possible experience. Carrying a large and expensive piece of hardware around can be cumbersome, especially if there are better alternatives available. In contrast, Microsoft's Xbox brand offers a more limited range of options for playing GTA 6 on non-console devices, with Xbox Cloud Gaming being the primary choice at present. GTA 6's flexibility in terms of gaming platforms has been compromised by Microsoft's recent changes to Xbox Cloud Gaming. The service, which was previously included for Game Pass subscribers without any limits, now restricts playtime to a maximum of 15 hours before requiring additional payment. This shift makes it less appealing compared to other options available for playing GTA 6 on non-console devices, such as those that support remote play from current-generation consoles. articles.title: Signal Restricts Screenshot Functionality Due to AI Agent Concerns
articles.summary: Signal is restricting screenshot functionality due to concerns that AI agents can access user data when taking screenshots. The move aims to protect user privacy and prevent sensitive information from being captured by OS-level AI agents.
articles.content: Encrypted messaging app Signal is taking steps to restrict screenshots due to concerns over AI agents and their potential impact on user privacy. Signal's President Meredith Whittaker highlighted the issue in a recent blog post, pointing out that features like Google's Gemini Intelligence and Apple's Siri AI Onscreen Awareness compromise the privacy missions of third-party developers by observing what's on a user's screen. These agentic features observe a user's screen to provide context for completing requests, but this raises concerns about sensitive data being captured, stored, and made accessible to OS-level AI agents. Whittaker emphasized that once this data is captured, it's outside of Signal's control, putting the privacy of all conversation participants at risk. Signal's decision to restrict screenshots raises concerns about the impact of Big Tech's AI strategy on third-party apps' privacy infrastructure. As AI features become increasingly integrated into operating systems, developers must adapt to conditions that undermine their hard-won security measures. This trend is evident in the growing presence of AI agents within services external to the OS, such as chatbots from OpenAI and Anthropic. Their integration has led to a shift in how third-party apps operate, forcing them to conform to new standards that compromise user data protection. The recent use of AI agents to verify Signal's code by Google DeepMind researchers highlights the potential risks involved. By building on Signal's own work, these researchers essentially proved the app's encryption works, setting a high bar for security guarantees within the app. However, this achievement is rendered meaningless if an agent can simply access messages through alternative means, such as retrieving content already present on a user's device via the filesystem. This vulnerability has been demonstrated by AI agents like Meta's Muse, which have been found to use permissions in unexpected ways to access apps and data. The development of rival AI agents by tech giants like Samsung and Apple further exacerbates these concerns, as their agents may also be capable of accessing app data through unconventional means. Signal's latest move to restrict screenshots stems from concerns that AI agents could access app data through unconventional means. The company's current protections don't extend to MacOS, leaving users on this platform vulnerable to potential privacy breaches. Signal's developers acknowledge the limitations of their tools in preventing AI agents from undermining application-level privacy. Without robust measures, even blocked attempts may still compromise user data. Signal advises against disabling its screenshot restrictions, as this would expose sensitive content to AI agents and potentially break the app's core functionality. Doing so could put both users' Signal content and that of their contacts at risk of being accessed by these agents, undermining the app's privacy guarantees. articles.title: Türkiye Launches Golden Visa Program
articles.summary: A new golden visa program has been launched by the Turkish government, allowing foreigners to stay in the country for up to five years with a minimum investment of $150,000.
articles.content: Türkiye has long been a magnet for international visitors, its strategic location at the crossroads of Europe, Asia, and the Middle East making it an attractive destination for travelers from around the world. The country's rich cultural heritage, including historic mosques and bustling bazaars, is just one aspect that draws in nearly 64 million visitors each year. With sun-kissed Mediterranean beaches and a unique blend of Ottoman-inspired cuisine, it's no wonder Türkiye remains such a popular choice among tourists. However, for those who plan to stay longer or even consider making the country their second home, a new golden visa program may be worth exploring, provided they have the necessary funds. A minimum investment of $150,000 is required for a three-year residence permit under this new initiative. A key aspect of the program is its flexibility in terms of where applicants can deposit their funds. Options include placing money in a local bank account, investing in government debt instruments or pension plans, and even purchasing real estate or contributing to venture capital funds, all with the aim of extending stays for up to five years. The new investment migration program in Türkiye has sparked interest among foreign investors, but it remains unclear when applications will begin or what specific documents are required for approval. Applications for other residence-by-investment permits in the country typically demand proof of financial means and health insurance, according to the government's Investment and Finance Office. However, these requirements may not apply to the new golden visa program announced by the president. Türkiye offers alternative relocation pathways for those who cannot afford or do not wish to invest $150,000. One option is a two-year Short-Term Residence Permit, which can be obtained for reasons such as tourism or university-sponsored research. After eight years of continuous residence in Türkiye, foreigners will become eligible to apply for the indefinite Long-Term Residence Permit, granting them almost all the same benefits as citizenship, except for civic duties like voting and mandatory military service. The cost of acquiring a Turkish passport has increased significantly. To be eligible for citizenship by investment, applicants must now invest at least $400,000 in real estate or contribute to sectors such as government bonds and venture capital funds. Wealthy travelers have been presented with alternative options through residency-by-investment programs around the world. In New Zealand, a $1 million NZD investment is required for a three-year work-to-residency track. Meanwhile, Greece offers a five-year permit for a 250,000 euro investment in a startup. Paraguay stands out as one of the more affordable relocation options due to its permanent residency program. Applicants can invest either $150,000 in tourism projects or $200,000 in stocks or real estate, making it comparable to Türkiye's new golden visa scheme starting at $150,000. articles.title: The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping Costume Designer Reveals Inspiration Process
articles.summary: A prequel to The Hunger Games, The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping is set 24 years before the events of The Hunger Games and 40 years after The Ballad of Songbirds Snakes.
articles.content: The red carpet has been abuzz with Elle Fanning's outrageous fashion choices as Effie Trinket in recent weeks, leaving fans and critics alike to wonder what inspired such daring style decisions. Fanning's character is a nod to the young Effie Trinket from The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping, a theatrical production set to premiere on November 20. This new take on the classic tale is based on Suzanne Collins' novel of the same name, published in 2025. It serves as a prequel to the original series, taking place 24 years before the events of The Hunger Games and 40 years after The Ballad of Songbirds Snakes. Bina Daigeler, the costume designer behind this new film, has been instrumental in bringing Effie's eccentric style to life. Working closely with her team, she created every single outfit from scratch, drawing on vintage specialists for a few select accessories. This meticulous approach allowed Daigeler to infuse each look with its own unique personality. To ensure that the costumes accurately reflected the distinctiveness of each district, Daigeler began by curating a mood board that highlighted the aesthetic differences between these 13 regions. To create costumes that would accurately reflect the distinctiveness of each district in The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping, Daigeler drew inspiration from a range of designers, including Alexander McQueen and John Galliano. "It was really like old couture fashion," she recalls, referencing the timeless appeal of these iconic houses. Daigeler's goal was to create pieces that would remain relevant for years to come, as she believes this is crucial when working on such an esteemed franchise. This approach ensured that her designs would be a fitting tribute to the series. Daigeler worked closely with Drusilla Sickle, played by Glenn Close, who sought to find a common thread throughout her costumes. To achieve this, Daigeler incorporated "cool accessories" to give Sickle's character strength and depth, culminating in one striking finale look that would leave a lasting impression. Daigeler aimed to capture Effie Trinket's personality through her fashion choices, resulting in a distinct concept for each outfit. Effie Trinket herself was a central focus of Daigeler's efforts, given her background as a stylist and her love of fashion. The film explores how young Effie Trinket evolved into the stylish character portrayed by Elizabeth Banks, with early scenes showcasing her more improvisational approach to fashion. As Effie's character progresses, her outfits become increasingly polished, reflecting her growing status as a fashion icon in the Capitol. Effie Trinket's outfits are not just about aesthetics; they're also about conveying her character's emotional state and social standing. In the Reaping scene of The Hunger Games: Sunrise, Effie's fashion choices reflect a growing sense of confidence and poise. Daigeler, the costume designer, sourced vintage pieces from around the world to create Effie's distinctive style. One notable example is her butterfly crystal rings, which add a touch of whimsy to her overall look. These subtle details are just a few of the fashion Easter eggs hidden throughout the film. Haymitch Abernathy also undergoes a sartorial transformation in The Hunger Games: Sunrise. His costume designer aimed for a more understated yet still stylish approach. Daigeler notes that Haymitch's clothes were deliberately aged to give them a worn, lived-in look. Effie Trinket's attention to detail extended to the character of President Snow as well, with a focus on conveying power through his attire. The designer worked closely with a London tailor who had previously collaborated with her, incorporating World War II military-inspired cuts and heavy fabrics into Snow's suits, which were then elevated with hand-embroidered lapels. The outfits were designed to reflect the character's authoritative presence, while also incorporating subtle fantasy elements to add depth and visual interest. articles.content: Hailey Bieber's Instagram post has sent shockwaves through the beauty community, showcasing a comprehensive skincare routine featuring an array of products to soothe and hydrate her skin. Among the diverse collection of traditional sheet masks, LED devices, rubber masks, and rich creams is one product that has particularly caught attention - a blue-tinted sheet mask that has sparked widespread curiosity. The mask in question is part of Pyderin's Hydrovuster line, specifically designed to provide hydration and calmness to sensitive skin. According to Jennifer Seo, head concierge at Aneue, the brand behind this innovative product, the Hydrovuster collection was created with soothing post-treatment skin or reactive skin in mind. The blue coloration of the mask is not merely for aesthetic appeal; it's a result of the inclusion of blue azulene, an anti-inflammatory ingredient that also reduces redness. The unique combination of ingredients in Hailey Bieber's viral blue K-beauty sheet mask is what sets it apart from other similar products on the market. According to Dr. Chang Son, a board-certified dermatologist based in NYC, this mask provides an intense dose of hydration that can be particularly beneficial for dry or dehydrated skin. The serum used in the mask is pharmaceutical-grade and contains PDRN in its highest purity. Seo explains that the treatment's high concentration allows it to synergize effectively with other key ingredients like blue azulene and mucin, promoting healing and soothing of the skin. Notably, the mask uses domestically sourced PDRN extracted from Korean salmon, which is a distinct advantage over some competing brands that may use internationally sourced PDRN derived from different types of fish. This difference in sourcing could potentially affect the purity and effectiveness of the product. Dr. Son highlights another key benefit of the sodium PDRN used in this mask: its enhanced water solubility makes it more suitable for topical applications and easier to incorporate into skin care products, such as creams or sheet masks like Hailey Bieber's viral sensation. This improved bioavailability could contribute to a more efficient delivery of the active ingredients to the skin, further amplifying their benefits. Pyderin's sheet mask contains 99 percent pure PDRN, which is also small enough at 97 kilodaltons to penetrate deep into the skin. This high concentration and optimal size of PDRN enable it to effectively deliver its benefits. The combination of pure PDRN and blue azulene makes Pyderin suitable for regular use on all skin types and tones, especially after treatments that can leave skin sensitive or irritated. Son notes that this mask would be particularly beneficial for patients with chronic dry or inflamed skin like rosacea. The mask is currently out of stock, but it will soon become available via Amazon in mid-to-late November. articles.title: Nvidia Cofounder Jensen Huang Resigns Amid Allegations of Personal Scandal
articles.summary: Jensen Huang has resigned as Nvidia CEO amidst allegations of a personal scandal involving a woman linked to China, sparking concerns about potential conflicts of interest and export regulations violations.
articles.content: Nvidia's cofounder Jensen Huang has resigned as CEO amidst allegations of a personal scandal. His resignation on November 12 came after it was discovered he had been involved in an affair with a woman linked to China, sparking concerns about potential conflicts of interest and export regulations violations. The controversy centres around Nvidia's business dealings with her company in Singapore, which received billions of dollars' worth of sales under Huang's leadership. It has also raised questions about whether his personal relationships influenced major business decisions. Huang's swift return to X after resigning was a surprise move that left many wondering how he managed to mobilize so quickly. Using cutting-edge technology such as Rubin GPUs, Huang may have accelerated the process of reviewing his own actions, potentially reducing what would normally take months into just a few days. However, this rapid turnaround didn't sit well with Nvidia's board, which swiftly rejected his offer to return. In fact, the board's decision was made so quickly that it seemed almost instantaneous, like a data center in Texas consuming massive amounts of water in a short amount of time. The search for Huang's replacement is now underway, but the push to restore him to his former position has not dissipated. A petition calling on Nvidia to rehire Huang has garnered over 200,000 signatures, with even the President of the United States weighing in on the matter by expressing support for Huang's return. Despite the board's rejection and a company-wide message from Kress assuring employees that "we got this," the efforts to bring Huang back are still ongoing. Some reports suggest that Huang may have had personal discussions with at least one board member about his potential reinstatement, leaving some directors open to the possibility. The Jensen affair continues to cast a long shadow over Nvidia's biggest IPO in history, dominating discussions at the New York Times DealBook conference just one day after the company's earnings call. Despite Anthropic's preparations for its historic market debut, the focus remained on Huang and his tumultuous tenure as CEO. OpenAI's Sam Altman and Greg Brockman took to the stage, expressing admiration for Huang but stopping short of endorsing his reinstatement. In a striking display of loyalty, Anduril CEO Palmer Luckey defended Jensen, arguing that no one could replace him in this critical moment due to his personal relationships with key business partners. According to Luckey, these connections are what make people willing to do business with Nvidia. Elon Musk's outrage over Huang's ousting was palpable as he likened the situation to the Chicago Bulls firing Michael Jordan during a playoff hot streak. In informal conversations during breaks at the conference, it became clear that opinions on the matter are sharply divided. The fervor surrounding Huang's reinstatement at Nvidia is a stark reminder of how corporate interests often take precedence over ethics and national security concerns. Those advocating for his return point to his exceptional leadership skills, arguing that he is irreplaceable and that letting him go would be a disservice to the company's past achievements. However, this line of thinking ignores the fact that Huang's personal behavior has raised serious questions about his fitness as a CEO, including allegations of dishonesty with the board and potential violations of export regulations. The cult-like reverence for founders who have built successful companies into global brands is also on full display in this debate, implying that their unique abilities should be left unchecked. Huang's decision to hand over senior executive posts to family members who showed interest in the chip business later in life has raised questions about nepotism and its impact on shareholders. While it may seem like a way to share power within the company, the practice of giving key positions to relatives can actually cost investors dearly, particularly if these individuals are not well-equipped for their roles. Moreover, Huang's failure to prepare a succession plan for Nvidia has left the company vulnerable in case he is no longer able to lead it. This oversight has been criticized by other business leaders, including Satya Nadella, who pointed out that companies need to have a clear plan in place for leadership transitions. Huang would be wise to abandon his efforts to regain control at Nvidia and instead focus on repairing his personal relationships. His family dynamics are in need of attention, as is his reputation, which could benefit from his cooperation with lawyers to address any outstanding issues. This approach would also enable him to avoid being associated with the company if its fortunes were to decline, allowing him to maintain a positive public image. articles.title: US Data Centers Drive Economic Growth but Create Labor Shortage
articles.summary: The rapid expansion of data centers in the US is driving significant economic growth, but it has created a pressing challenge for the telecommunications industry due to a shortage of skilled workers.
articles.content: The rapid expansion of data centers is driving significant economic growth in the US, with an estimated $800 billion expected to be spent on these facilities by 2026 alone. However, this boom has created a pressing challenge for the telecommunications industry: it requires a workforce that can build and connect these data centers, but there simply aren't enough workers available to meet demand. According to AT&T CEO John Stankey, the shortage of skilled construction and technician workers is becoming increasingly urgent. By 2032, he estimates that nearly 200,000 additional workers will be needed to keep pace with industry growth. Stankey warns that unless this issue is addressed, the US risks being unable to support the rapid development of AI infrastructure. He notes that all these new data centers need to be connected if we want to continue growing as an economy. As a result, Stankey sees an opportunity for Gen Z to enter the workforce and fill this critical gap, particularly since the traditional college-to-career pipeline is becoming less reliable. As workers in various industries struggle to find qualified candidates, a significant gap has emerged in the job market for technical roles such as fiber splicers and telecommunications installers. These entry-level positions often don't require a bachelor's degree, but instead offer on-the-job training that equips workers with the necessary skills. According to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, the median annual salary for these jobs is around $70,000, although total compensation can reach six figures when overtime and bonuses are factored in. Companies like AT&T are actively hiring for these roles, with a spokesperson explaining that they prioritize candidates' skills and potential over their educational background. This approach has proven effective, as evidenced by the success of new hires who receive extensive training before being certified to perform complex tasks. The demand for skilled tradespeople extends beyond telecommunications, with the data center construction boom putting pressure on the supply of electricians, plumbers, and HVAC technicians. The Alliance for America's Skilled Trades, a coalition of leading companies including AT&T, Meta, Google, and Ford, has been working to address the severe shortage of skilled tradespeople in the US labor market. According to Stankey, CEO of AT&T, the existing stigma surrounding careers that don't require a college degree is a major obstacle to filling the estimated 1.7 million skilled trades openings every year through 2035. Stankey emphasizes that careers like telecommunications and fiber installation are not only stable but also lucrative, with salaries reaching up to $70,000 per year, without the need for a four-year degree. He argues that these jobs offer a unique combination of physical and mental challenges, which should be valued equally alongside traditional white-collar professions. The solution to this labor shortage lies in changing societal attitudes towards work, Stankey suggests, by recognizing the validity and worth of careers that don't conform to traditional expectations. articles.title: Plestia Alaqad Publishes Diary-Memoir The Eyes of Gaza
articles.summary: The book chronicles Plestia Alaqad's experiences as a young Palestinian journalist during the weeks following October 7 in Gaza.
articles.content: Plestia Alaqad's decision to publish her diary-memoir, The Eyes of Gaza, has brought a deeply personal account of life in Gaza to the world stage. As she reflects on this choice, Alaqad acknowledges that making her intimate and private writings public was a challenging task. The book chronicles Alaqad's experiences as a young Palestinian journalist during the harrowing weeks following October 7 in Gaza. Her own journey began when she returned home in 2022 after studying new media and journalism at Eastern Mediterranean University in Cyprus. Alaqad's reporting often focused on ordinary people, positioning herself as their voice in the midst of chaos. In the early days, she spoke with her neighbors and local children, capturing moments of tenderness amidst the turmoil. Her own account also includes the expulsion of over 100,000 Gazans in the first few days. Her stories were largely shared through her Instagram account, which gained a significant following of around two million people. Many of her images were republished by prominent media outlets like the BBC, The New York Times, PBS NewsHour, and The Washington Post. Plestia Alaqad's reporting style is characterized by its relatability, capturing the mundane in extraordinary situations. She has relocated to Lebanon, where she is pursuing her master’s degree, a significant departure from her Gaza roots. The sense of community in Gaza is one aspect that Alaqad cherishes deeply. She recalls the close-knit relationships within her building with fondness. Her neighbors were like family to her; they offered support and companionship whenever needed, exemplified by Dana, who lived next door and was a constant presence in her life. Plestia Alaqad's writing ambitions extend far beyond her current projects. She believes it's essential for people like herself to continue creating work that showcases their talents and artistic expression. Her statement "There's more to us than being occupied" reflects the sentiment of many individuals who feel suffocated by the pressures of daily life, leaving little time for personal pursuits. Alaqad's desire is to produce content that highlights human stories and experiences, allowing readers to connect with others on a deeper level. In recent times, Alaqad has been involved in writing about people she finds inspiring, such as Renad Atallah, whose story was featured in The New Arab. Additionally, Alaqad has started her own newsletter on Substack, where she shares personal essays every week, often focusing on themes like Gaza, girlhood, and friendship. Alaqad's ultimate goal is to tell stories about a free Palestine one day, and as a journalist, she feels that her work remains incomplete without continuing to report from the ground in Gaza, sharing Palestinian stories with the world. As a voracious reader of nonfiction books and memoirs, Alaqad has always been fascinated by people's experiences and stories. Her curiosity about human nature is matched only by her desire to learn from others' perspectives. Alaqad's affinity for personal writings extends beyond literary works, with Franz Kafka's letters and the correspondence between Ghassan Kanafani and Ghada al-Samman being particular favorites. This interest in understanding people's thoughts and emotions has led her to appreciate personal reflections and diaries. Growing up, Alaqad kept a diary as a way of expressing herself without fear of judgment. For her, journaling was, and remains, a safe space where she can write freely. It is this need for self-expression that drives her creative endeavors. The first product under Alaqad's brand Neya will be a journal, designed to provide a personal and secure outlet for users. Available in four colors, each journal features gentle reminders on the hardcover and inspirational quotes throughout its pages. As a refugee who has experienced the trauma of displacement, journaling serves as a vital lifeline for reconnecting with oneself amidst chaos. The transition from private diarist to public figure was daunting, particularly when one's personal thoughts and emotions are shared with a global audience. Sharing intimate moments with strangers can be overwhelming, especially when those moments involve pain, loss, and resilience in the face of unimaginable circumstances. Living between two worlds - the comfort and security of education and opportunities abroad versus the harsh realities of war-torn homelands - presents its own set of challenges. Time seems to have stood still in Gaza as the world around it continues to evolve and progress at an unprecedented pace. The stark contrast between stagnation and growth is a defining characteristic of life in this war-torn region, where one can find despair alongside resilience on every corner. The photo series "Eyes of Gaza" poignantly captures these disparate elements, juxtaposing sorrow with optimism in striking visuals that leave viewers spellbound. By confronting the complexities of human emotions, the photographer aims to inspire action and empathy among those who experience the images.
